title: Ensuring Adherence to “Digital First But Not Digital Only” Approach across Government Agencies
what_it_is: Ensuring Adherence to “Digital First But Not Digital Only” Approach across Government Agencies

sections.label: Digital Service Standards guidance
sections.summary: Agencies strive to make digital services easy to use, guided by the Digital Service Standards.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: First, agencies strive to make digital services easy to use, guided by the Digital Service Standards (DSS).

sections.label: New centres and digital skills
sections.summary: Two more centres will be established at Woodlands Civic Centre and Bukit Merah Town Central by end of 2024, and IMDA launched the Digital Skills for Life framework in January 2024.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: Two more centres will be established at Woodlands Civic Centre and Bukit Merah Town Central by the end of 2024 to achieve a wider outreach to citizens.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: For example, the Infocomm Media Development Authority launched the Digital Skills for Life framework in January 2024 to equip Singaporeans with the necessary knowledge, skills and attitudes to navigate the digital space, carry out daily tasks and stay safe online.

sections.label: Training programmes and Silver Digital Ambassadors
sections.summary: There are training programmes explained in the House and outside, and Silver Digital Ambassadors are trained.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: We have a number of training programmes that we have explained in this House and outside.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: We have the Silver Digital Ambassadors as well that we train.

sections.label: Real-life experience and engagement metrics
sections.summary: Real-life experience is taken seriously to re-engineer products, digital drop-off is not specifically tracked, and metrics show increasing acceptability, engagement and utilisation over time.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: We take that seriously, that real-life experience and we will try to re-engineer those products to improve the experience.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: We do not specifically track the digital drop-off that the Member talked about.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: The metrics that we have, they show an increasing acceptability and increasing engagement and increasing utilisation over time.

sections.label: ServiceSG Centres for resident assistance
sections.summary: MCI could facilitate to reduce frustrations, and residents should be directed to ServiceSG Centres where staff help conduct transactions or navigate online space.

sentences.speaker: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng (Jalan Besar)
sentences.text: So, I thought MCI could be a facilitator to ensure that this does not happen so often because it creates a lot of frustrations on the ground.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: I would recommend that her residents who are in the position that she described should best be directed to a ServiceSG Centre because that is where there are staff who are able to help them conduct the transaction on their behalf or help them navigate the online space and do so in a way that perhaps gives them some confidence about the security and safety of the transaction.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: That is what the ServiceSG Centres are for – to assist the residents in these transactions.
